summary.result: The results indicate that VE-dampers alone are not sufficient to rehabilitate such a concrete frame.
summary.background: The frame located in the most severe seismic area, zone 4, is assumed to be designed and detailed for gravity load requirements only.
summary.method: The retrofit of the building is attempted using viscoelastic (VE) dampers.
